adversary_breaks.expected: After a confirmation has been sent, 'blocked' is an unresolved outcome: stay in confirm_unknown/held ('may have completed', Close + Retry/check status only), never assert nothing_deleted, never re-arm a new request/challenge for the same account. deletion.ts already has the honest copy for this (confirmIssueMessage('blocked')) but the terminal mapping wins.
adversary_breaks.observed: VERIFIED (exit 1, 2 failed). ATTACK 1: request OK -> confirm lost to network -> GET status returns state 'blocked'. Screen renders 'The server declined to delete this account. Nothing was deleted — contact support if you still want it removed.' plus the ordinary 'Delete your account? / Keep my account / Continue to delete' review UI, i.e. a new request can be minted. ATTACK 2: POST confirm answers 409 account.deletion_blocked -> same 'Nothing was deleted' + Continue to delete. Root cause (INFERRED): deletion.ts terminalMessage('blocked') -> {status:'failed', outcome:'nothing_deleted'} and isTerminalServerState treats 'blocked' as done; the transport maps 409 account.deletion_blocked -> {kind:'blocked'} and deletionOperation records serverState 'blocked' after a sent confirmation. Per 20260907001500_account_deletion_operations.sql the server returns 'blocked' precisely when confirmed_at is set AND (auth_deleted_at IS NOT NULL, auth.users row already gone, attempts>=8, or status window lapsed) — i.e. after the confirmation was accepted and possibly partially executed.
adversary_breaks.repro: cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/w08AttackManageAccountDeletion.test.tsx -t 'ATTACK 1'   (and -t 'ATTACK 2' for the 409 account.deletion_blocked-on-confirm variant)
adversary_breaks.title: Server `blocked` after a SENT confirmation renders 'Nothing was deleted' and re-arms a fresh deletion request

adversary_breaks.expected: Once the status window has closed the screen stops polling (no timer re-armed at 0 ms, bounded journal reads) and tells the user the window closed / outcome could not be confirmed (Close + contact support), never an endless spinner.
adversary_breaks.observed: VERIFIED (exit 1). Confirmation answered in_progress, process death, relaunch 25 h later (statusExpiresAt passed). Screen shows 'observing' spinner with only Close; after 25 rounds of advancing fake timers by 0 ms the journal was read 50 times (2 per round, unbounded), 12 timers pending, zero network status calls, no message. INFERRED: poll() -> held('status_expired') -> settle() reopens the row -> durableState maps phase 'observing' to in_progress with the old nextAttemptAtMs -> screen setTimeout(..., 0) -> poll again; the status_expired copy ('The window for checking this deletion has closed…') is unreachable.
adversary_breaks.title: Status window lapse while `observing` becomes a 0 ms local poll loop with a spinner that never resolves

adversary_breaks.expected: When the status capability has expired the UI says so ('The window for checking this deletion has closed…') and does not offer a live retry that cannot do anything (or the retry performs a real status check).
adversary_breaks.observed: VERIFIED (exit 1). Confirmation lost to network -> process death -> relaunch after 25 h. Dialog shows 'Deletion status unknown … Check your connection and retry' with an enabled 'Retry deletion'; pressing it makes zero network calls and re-renders the identical generic text. The dedicated status_expired copy in deletion.ts confirmIssueMessage is never surfaced because settle() reopens the row and the reopened confirm_pending row carries lastIssue null.
adversary_breaks.title: After the status window lapses, 'Retry deletion' is a silent no-op and the window-closed message is never shown

adversary_breaks.expected: Product invariant: unknown/corrupt state never becomes fabricated empty history. A journal row that fails to parse over an operation with a sent confirmation must surface as a record failure / unresolved deletion (Close + contact support), never as a fresh deletion flow that can mint a second request and claim nothing was deleted.
adversary_breaks.observed: VERIFIED (exit 1). Row phase column 'confirm_pending' but document JSON phase mutated to 'confirm_pendin' (json_valid CHECK still passes). Relaunch: Delete account opens 'QUESTION 1 OF 2 / What's making you leave?' — the sent, unresolved confirmation is invisible. Follow-through (VERIFIED in a debug run, not asserted in the pushed test): Skip survey -> Continue to delete mints a NEW POST delete-request (2 total) and a second journal row {operation_id:null, phase:'request_pending'} beside the corrupt one, with copy 'Nothing has been deleted — retry the request'.
adversary_breaks.title: A semantically corrupt journal document over a SENT confirmation re-enters as empty history: fresh exit survey and a second delete-request
